verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same. Both share the same flaws. The SOLSTICE logo and the bottle are shrunk to tiny, near-illegible marks while the headline takes over the banner. The legal fine print is about the same size as the subhead and is jammed beside the CTA in a cramped right-hand cluster. The subhead crowds the top edge, and the tilted sale ribbon collides with the left edge area without any clear alignment to the other elements.
